source: EmberEngine's own 3D props: content/models/blender kits (headless Blender 5.2) + the Meshy hearth. tools/scripts/models/catalog_models.py merges them into content/data/editor-catalog.json.
units: 1 unit = one hex radius (a human is 2.65 units, ~0.68 m). height/width = the authored size, so the engine's uniform fit is 1:1. file = the cooked asset's source path under the mesh pack's staging root (build/meshes/src-v2/ember/...).
